hierarchy.purpose: continuous volcanic island, route context, horizon, circulation, and atmosphere
central source-defining fortress, Arena aperture, forge core, and guardian
footprint-stable Hatchery, Habit, Mystery, and Wisdom L1-L3 structures
canonical staged pickup/spend loop and four cumulative visible bridge results
caretaker, inhabitants, ambience, materials, construction, and action-ready metadata

global_exclusions: No baked HUD, text, counters, fake tile icons, token, or source-image route geometry.
No change to canonical 36-tile transforms, landmark-stop semantics, rewards, currencies, Arena cadence, or state ownership.
No generated hidden view may override a visible source contour.
No detail or motion polish before the owning macro form passes the 0.85 naked multi-view gate.
No sibling may reshape another part's owned socket or attachment collar.
No Island 005/007 geometry recolour presented as a new world.

ambiguities.question: Runtime identity conflicts with existing catalogue copy.
ambiguities.recommendation: Approve the explicit source-led retheme from Golden Sands/Golden Winds Cup to Lava Labyrinth/Blaze Trials Cup.

ambiguities.question: The source shows Island 043.
ambiguities.recommendation: Keep runtime 020 authoritative and treat baked 043 as non-runtime pixels.
ambiguities.impact: none on geometry; recorded provenance only

ambiguities.question: Rear citadel, Arena interior, bridge machinery, and guardian are hidden.
ambiguities.recommendation: After approval, create isolated secondary-inferred construction sheets constrained by exact visible silhouettes.
ambiguities.impact: rear volume, motion sockets, and guardian design

ambiguities.question: The source contains a dense approximate route close to the fortress.
ambiguities.recommendation: Adapt fortress terraces around the canonical protected route corridor even where this slightly opens the source composition.

representative_first_slice.reason: The central Crucible Citadel is the strongest identity feature and highest-risk cross-view volume. A clay island shell and canonical corridor guide are sufficient context; materials, forge effects, guardian, and micro-detail remain locked.
